activities.name: Too-Ashuu Pass
activities.desc: 3,200 m pass and tunnel on the Bishkek–Osh road.

activities.name: Suusamyr Valley
activities.desc: Wide high pastures dotted with summer yurts.

activities.name: Kokomeren River Gorge
activities.desc: Red-rock river canyon down towards Kyzyl Oi.

activities.name: Karakeche Pass
activities.desc: Rough dirt pass past coal mines, gateway to Song Kul.

activities.name: Song Kul Lake
activities.desc: Alpine lake at 3,016 m with summer yurt camps.

activities.name: Kyzart Pass ride
activities.desc: Ride over the pass above the lake's north-east side.

activities.name: Song Kul south shore ridge walk
activities.desc: Informal walk up the south-shore ridge (no official trail).

activities.name: Moldo-Ashuu Pass
activities.desc: 3,346 m pass with famous switchbacks.

activities.name: Tash Rabat caravanserai area walk
activities.desc: Walk around the 15th-century Silk Road caravanserai.

activities.name: Tash Rabat valley ridge viewpoint
activities.desc: Informal climb to a ridge viewpoint above the valley.

activities.name: Naryn
activities.desc: Regional town on the Naryn river; fuel and supplies.

activities.name: Dolon Pass
activities.desc: 3,030 m paved pass between Naryn and Kochkor.

activities.name: Skazka (Fairytale) Canyon
activities.desc: Wind-carved red sandstone formations.

activities.name: Issyk Kul swim at Kaji Sai
activities.desc: Swim in the lake at the Kaji Sai beach.

activities.name: Barskoon Waterfall
activities.desc: Tall waterfall in the Barskoon gorge.

activities.name: Jeti Oguz (Seven Bulls) rocks
activities.desc: Red cliffs of the Seven Bulls and Broken Heart rock.

activities.name: Valley of Flowers hike
activities.desc: Hike up the Jeti Oguz gorge to the Valley of Flowers.

activities.name: Altyn Arashan hot springs and valley walk
activities.desc: Natural hot spring pools in an alpine valley.

activities.name: Issyk Kul north shore ride
activities.desc: Lakeside riding with the Tian Shan across the water.

activities.name: Boom Gorge
activities.desc: Narrow Chui river gorge, the gateway to Issyk Kul.
